description: This file defines utility functions for resolving Discord allowlist tokens, building results, and filtering Discord guild summaries based on name or ID. It imports types and functions from other modules related to Discord guilds, tokens, and slugs.

methods.name: export function resolveDiscordAllowlistToken(token: string): string | undefined { resolveDiscordAllowlistToken
methods.description: Normalizes a Discord token string for allowlist purposes by calling the external function 'normalizeDiscordToken' with a specific key.

methods.name: export function buildDiscordUnresolvedResults<T extends { input: string; resolved: boolean }>( buildDiscordUnresolvedResults
methods.description: Builds an array of results by applying a provided function to each input string in a list, useful for creating unresolved Discord entries.

methods.name: export function findDiscordGuildByName( findDiscordGuildByName
methods.description: Finds a Discord guild summary from a list by normalizing the input name to a slug and matching it to guilds' slugs.

methods.name: export function filterDiscordGuilds( filterDiscordGuilds
methods.description: Filters a list of guild summaries by either guild ID or name, returning matching guilds accordingly.

ctags.name: buildDiscordUnresolvedResults
ctags.pattern: /^export function buildDiscordUnresolvedResults<T extends { input: string; resolved: boolean }>($/
